decision_reason: RNA assembly succeeds and passes Vaxrank's evidence gates, but no target epitope passes the default prediction filters.
dna_only: A 15-nt deletion inside a repetitive histone sequence does not by itself identify the expressed protein context or a useful class-I target.
interpretation: Assembly is necessary but not sufficient. The expressed sequence is resolved, yet Vaxrank correctly returns no vaccine candidate for the configured patient HLA set.
limitation: A zero-target result is retained rather than hidden or forced into selection.
summary_rna: ONT assembly: 13 ALT, 2 OTHER; no passing target binder
title: H1-2 repetitive 15-nt deletion
